question: By what percentage did the measured NO emissions rise when the NH3 co-firing ratio went from 0 to 10% at a PA/SA ratio of 1:0?
rendered:
The document states that NO emissions increased from 169 to 308 ppm when the NH3 co-firing ratio increased from 0 to 10% at a PA/SA ratio of 1:0. 

To calculate the percentage increase, we use the formula:
((308 - 169) / 169) * 100 = 82.5%

So, the measured NO emissions rose by 82.5% when the NH3 co-firing ratio went from 0 to 10% at a PA/SA ratio of 1:0.
